# Boots of Elvenkind (`magic-items:boots-of-elvenkind`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** No

Wondrous Item

While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
